title: Uni Retail Platform (URP)
summary: Merchant-facing logistics SaaS platform spanning shipments, payments, carrier integrations, webhooks, campaign automation, cross-border shipping, and analytics.
details: Built backend services on AWS Lambda with TypeScript, Prisma, and Zod across URP domains. Supported the U.S. cross-border soft launch with HTS-based duty automation, tariff transparency, and pickup/serviceability logic; helped build the marketing campaign MVP with event-driven payment-method triggers and referral workflow foundations; and migrated merchant webhook configuration toward a DB-driven self-service model.

title: uniuni.com Infrastructure & Web Tracking Separation
summary: Infrastructure separation project moving public shipment tracking traffic away from the WordPress-based uniuni.com site toward a dedicated tracking platform.
details: Reviewed the proposed dedicated EKS, ALB, and CloudFront architecture for tracking.uniuni.com, validating routing strategy, IAM scope, Terraform/Terragrunt tfvars handling, CloudWatch notification gaps, DNS/certificate requirements, and production cutover risks. Coordinated readiness questions around English/French route coverage, Next.js static assets, ALB origin verification, and redirects from existing uniuni.com tracking paths.

title: Deployment & Reliability Automation
summary: Production and standby release workflows for UniUni services across U.S. and Canada environments, focused on safer blue-green operations.
details: Supported shell-script-based blue-green deployments and hardened operational workflows around standby scale-up, release comments, service mapping, and environment checks. Debugged ECR authentication, Docker multi-arch manifests, ASG scale-up, tag parsing, and config path issues while turning recurring deployment knowledge into repeatable runbooks.

title: Tropical Daydream — E-Commerce Store
summary: Full-stack e-commerce plant store built from scratch using AI-augmented vibe coding. Serverless AWS SAM backend with React + Tailwind frontend, Stripe payments, and admin dashboard.
details: End-to-end e-commerce platform: React/Tailwind storefront with product catalog, cart, and Stripe embedded checkout. Serverless API on AWS SAM (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3) with JWT auth, presigned image uploads, order management, and webhook-driven payment processing. Built entirely via AI-augmented workflows.

title: Harry Rosen (E-Commerce Platform)
summary: Played a core role as a senior backend engineer, driving architectural decisions, service migrations, and reliability improvements in a production-critical environment.
details: Led full infrastructure migration from IBM Cloud to GCP (GKE, Cloud Functions). Architected blue-green CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, reducing incidents by 50%. Tuned MongoDB sharding for 25% latency reduction. Migrated retry systems to Kafka and designed real-time event syncing for CommerceTools/Algolia. Rebuilt loyalty system (TalonOne) and integrated headless checkout (Bold Commerce).

title: Headless Checkout (Bold Commerce)
summary: Integrated Bold Commerce headless checkout (beta) with modular adapters and fallbacks for a mobile-first checkout experience.
details: Integrated Bold Commerce's beta headless checkout in production: worked with Bold engineering, implemented robust error handling, fallback logic, and cross-team testing. Launched with zero downtime and measurable improvements in page speed and cart conversion.

title: Shopfinalcut
summary: Launched a new outlet store reusing core services with feature flags, shipping, and subtotal/discount adjustments.
details: Added feature flags across data models and services to support a new outlet store; updated checkout integration for same-day shipping and subtotal/discount logic; launched shopfinalcut successfully using the existing backend platform.

title: FintelConnect — Affiliate Platform
summary: Frontend lead + full-stack contributor for a real-time affiliate marketing platform adopted by banks and fintechs.
details: Led frontend development of real-time dashboards and performance optimizations; contributed to backend architecture and AWS infra (Lambda, EC2, MongoDB, Auth0). Platform won two FinXTech Awards including Best Solution for Revenue Growth.

title: Eventer (Full-Stack)
summary: Group project for an outdoor events management system using Google APIs and Open-Weather API.
details: Responsible for using Google APIs (OAuth, Map and Location) and Open-Weather API on the Activities Page and Admin Page, and image files transformation by Multer.

title: Jungle (E-commerce)
summary: Implemented core e-commerce features including Sold Out badges, Admin Categories, and User Auth.
details: Implemented features of "Product Sold Out - Badge", "Admin Categories", "User Authentication", "Order Details", "E-mail Receipt" and "Product Ratings". Fixed bugs including "Missing Admin Security" and "Checking out with Empty Cart".

title: ChattyApp
summary: A multi-user real-time communication app built with React and WebSockets.
details: Real-time messaging application featuring live user online status, message notifications, and instant updates using WebSockets. Built with a React frontend and a Node.js WebSocket server.

title: Wordle Game
summary: A modern, full-stack implementation of the popular word-guessing game with real-time multiplayer and 'cheating' modes.
details: Built a client-server architecture with React and Node.js/Express. Features include a 'Host Cheating' mode (Absurdle style), real-time multiplayer using WebSockets (Head-to-Head, Race, Hybrid modes), player statistics tracking in localStorage, and an interactive on-screen keyboard.

title: Charity (IOS Mobile App)
summary: Collaborated on a mental health mobile app offering anxiety treatment plans and mini-games.
details: Collaborated on Clarity, a mental health mobile app that offers personalized anxiety treatment plans, mini-games, data tracking, and a community message board. Designed and implemented the UFO game, an interactive mini-game aimed at reducing anxiety through engaging, fast-paced gameplay.

title: Bidfy — MVP Delivery
summary: Delivered an MVP (RSS feed + AWS Lambda + DynamoDB) quickly to validate market response in 3 sprints.
details: Built a cost-efficient MVP using serverless components (Lambda, DynamoDB) and an RSS ingestion pipeline to validate product-market fit in a short timeframe.
